name: hacker-news-top-stories
title: Hacker News Top Stories
description: A menubar extension to view top stories on Hacker News based on a configurable points threshold.
author: KevinBatdorf

commands.name: view-top-stories
commands.title: Hacker News Top Stories Menu Bar
commands.description: View recent Hacker News stories based on a configurable points threshold.

tools.name: summarize-unread-stories
tools.title: Summarize Unread Stories
tools.description: Get your unread Hacker News stories with their articles and top comments, ready to summarize.

tools.name: get-comments
tools.title: Get Comments
tools.description: Get what people are saying about a Hacker News story, top comment threads first.

tools.name: search-comments
tools.title: Search Comments
tools.description: Search Hacker News comments by keyword, in one story or across all of Hacker News.

tools.name: read-article
tools.title: Read Article
tools.description: Read what a Hacker News story is about: the article it links to, or the text of an Ask HN post.

preferences.name: points
preferences.title: Minimum Points
preferences.description: Minimum points to show stories. Changing it starts the story list over; stories you've read stay read.

preferences.name: useStoryIcon
preferences.title: Notification Icon
preferences.description: Use the story icon instead of the default Hacker News icon.
preferences.label: Use Story Icons

preferences.name: syncWithICloud
preferences.title: iCloud Sync
preferences.description: Sync read stories between your Macs through the "Raycast Hacker News" folder in iCloud Drive.
preferences.label: Sync Read Stories with iCloud Drive

preferences.name: summaryLimit
preferences.title: Stories per Summary
preferences.description: How many unread stories Raycast AI summarizes at a time.

preferences.name: markReadByAi
preferences.title: Raycast AI
preferences.description: Mark a story as read when Raycast AI reads its article or comments.
preferences.label: Mark Stories Raycast AI Reads as Read

ai.instructions: For any question about Hacker News, new stories or the user's stories, call summarize-unread-stories. Never answer from memory, and never describe what you are about to do instead of calling the tool. For each story it returns, write the title in bold with its points, a two or three sentence summary of the article, the two top comments in one line each with the commenter's name, then a line reading [Article](articleUrl) | [Comments](discussionUrl). If articleError is set, say the article couldn't be read and summarize from the comments. If moreUnread is above zero, end by saying how many more unread stories there are. If no stories come back, say the user is all caught up. Use read-article or get-comments when the user wants more on one story, and search-comments to find something in a discussion. If the user asks to mark stories read, call no tool: say you can't, and that they can mark them read from the menu bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
